environment: isolated Chromium; localhost synthetic SSE provider; real AI UI/Store with synthetic Obsidian

checks.name: unbound sidebar disables Send and makes no provider request
settings performs all four compatibility requests and stores the key outside plugin/local data
native sidebar keeps the 440-wide pane, 32-high header, Template row and bottom composer
real composer sends only explicit selected text and keeps the library unchanged
Chat includes the previous exchange and Ask starts a separate request
AI presets follow the observed native None, Guide, Quiz and Explain menu
Guide requests one step at a time using only explicitly attached context
card tools show an editable preview and only an explicit save creates a card without review enrollment
outline preview edits save real hierarchy and undo removes the whole generated outline
Markdown previews include an editable source link when selected material has a document
real image upload uses multimodal input and user-edited Markdown saves to a new file
editing a model immediately unbinds chat and reopening settings never reveals the saved key
dragging one source card attaches that card and never uploads other library content
Stop cancels a live stream without saving generated content
cancel restores the submitted question for an explicit retry
hiding the panel aborts the live stream and reopening preserves partial replies without sending another request
closing the sidebar disposes its UI and in-memory conversation state
an enabled Claudian defaults to direct generation and hides the custom Mini/Normal controls
Claudian directly streams selected content back into an editable preview without altering its existing draft
direct replies retain their selected source and cannot be saved twice from the same preview
Claudian provider failure restores the question and selected source without a new import
Claudian image paste is rejected before consuming the draft or making a request
opt-in native Claudian replies from the linked session automatically appear in MarginStudy; unrelated sessions and prior history are not read
Claudian 2.3.30 image upload sends a real image block and displays the streamed reply in the same panel
a pasted Claudian reply is editable and only Save creates a card without review enrollment
a manually pasted Markdown outline saves real hierarchy and remains one undoable transaction
unknown Claudian versions show an editable manual-copy fallback without appending or sending
